name: Browser type
description: Types text into the visible in-app browser, optionally focusing/clearing a target element first and pressing Enter afterwards.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 向用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器输入文本：可先按 CSS 选择器或角色快照的 role/name 聚焦/清空目标元素，输入后可选回车提交，操作对用户实时可见。
localizedDescription.en-US: Types text into the visible in-app browser, optionally focusing/clearing a target element first and pressing Enter afterwards.

text.description: The text to type into the page.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to focus before typing.

role.description: Accessibility role from a format=roles snapshot (used when selector is omitted). Unique match required unless nth is set.

name.description: Accessible name from a format=roles snapshot. Optional with role.

nth.description: 0-based index among role/name matches. Use when several same-named roles match.

clear.description: Clear the target field before typing. Defaults to false.

submit.description: Press Enter after typing. Defaults to false.
